cite_pills.title: What USB power rating do I need to power my Starlink Mini?

turns.answer:
Starlink Mini USB-C Power Requirements

The Starlink Mini can be powered through USB-C using a compatible USB Power Delivery (USB-PD) source and a USB-C-to-Starlink DC power cable.

Specification

	

Requirement




USB-C PD voltage

	

20V DC




USB-C PD power

	

100W minimum recommended




USB-C PD current

	

5A




Typical power consumption

	

25–40W




USB-C cable

	

100W (5A) rated, e-marked




Connector

	

USB-C to Starlink Mini DC barrel connector

Important: Although the Starlink Mini typically consumes only 25–40W, a 65W USB-C charger may not reliably start or operate it. A 100W USB-C PD source is the safer choice.

What to check on your charger or power bank

Look for an output specification that explicitly says:

USB-C Output: 20V ⎓ 5A (100W)

A charger advertised as 100W is not sufficient unless one USB-C port can deliver the full 100W.

Starlink officially specifies 100W USB-PD, even though normal consumption is much lower.
